title: How ranking works
intro: In the "Recommended" order, each stay's score is the weighted sum of the components below. The "Why this ranking?" link on each result card shows how much every component contributes. Paid placement and commission rates do not affect the ranking.

table.caption: Components and weights of the recommended order
table.weightWithQuery: Weight (with search text or a destination)

priceFit.label: Price fit
priceFit.description: How favourable the tax-inclusive total for your selected dates is compared with the other results.

rating.label: Guest rating
rating.description: Bayesian-adjusted average rating, so listings with few reviews are not over-promoted.

popularity.label: Review count
popularity.description: Logarithmic scale of the number of reviews tied to verified stays.

personal.label: Personalisation
personal.description: If you are signed in, city/type similarity to your past bookings and favourites.

semantic.label: Search text similarity
semantic.description: Similarity between your search text and the listing text.

footnote: When you sort by price, rating or most liked, only that criterion is used.
withQueryNote: When you enter a destination or search text, search text similarity counts for more so that results match what you are looking for; in that case the weights in the third column are used.
experimentNote: To improve the ranking, some visitors may see an experimental, self-learning ranking model. It uses only the components above, and paid placement or commission does not affect it either.
